composed.brief:
The new Tru Beauty by Trevor digital experience must pivot from a broken utility to a premium, high-conversion destination. The visual language will be anchored in 'Quiet Luxury': utilizing a sophisticated palette of deep forest green (trust/clinical) and champagne gold (warmth/luxury) to communicate authority and self-love. Layouts must employ generous whitespace, asymmetrical grid structures, and a rhythm that alternates between high-impact full-width editorial imagery and scannable, benefit-driven text blocks. The typographic system will use Cormorant Garamond for elegant, high-contrast headings that evoke bespoke editorial magazines, paired with Montserrat for high-legibility, modern utility in body copy and CTA buttons.

Technically, the site must prioritize a zero-friction conversion path. The 'Book Online' CTA will be persistent in the primary header and sticky on mobile, utilizing a secondary button style that pops against the dark header. We will implement a 'Provider-First' section, featuring professional portraits of the 90+ year combined experience team to establish immediate trust. Every service page must feature a 'Why Choose Us' module and a direct link to the NextPatient booking flow, removing all barriers to entry.

To address the catastrophic audit findings, the build must include a server-side restoration strategy that includes a custom-designed 404 page—branded with a soft-focus clinic detail and a 'Return Home' button—to ensure that even in downtime, the brand perception remains intact. Post-restoration, the site will feature a 'Trust Bar' on the homepage (featured reviews and provider credentials) to replace the current lack of social proof. The structure will be modular, prioritizing mobile responsiveness and rapid load times, ensuring that the luxury aesthetic does not impede performance. By integrating the booking platform directly into the UX flow rather than as an external afterthought, we will transform the site from a placeholder into a high-converting engine that reflects the premium nature of the Henderson practice.

IMAGERY: Utilize high-key, editorial-style imagery featuring soft, golden-hour natural lighting to emphasize skin texture and clinic warmth. Visually, we will move away from competing background watermarks, opting for generous, breathable negative space that centers the content. The layout will utilize a sophisticated 'rhythm of repose'—alternating between full-bleed hero imagery and structured, grid-based service modules that prioritize scannability. Typography will be strictly controlled: Lora for editorial-style headings that evoke authority, and Tenor Sans for body copy to ensure high-legibility and modern clinical precision. To address the CRO audit, we will implement a 'sticky' utility bar containing a treatment finder and a global 'Book Online' CTA. The hero section will be rewritten to focus on patient transformation rather than clinic services, featuring a dual-CTA approach: a primary 'Book Consultation' and a secondary lead-magnet button for a 'Comprehensive Aesthetic Longevity Guide' to capture top-of-funnel leads. We will replace dense navigation with a tiered mega-menu optimized for mobile-first interaction, ensuring that service discovery is intuitive and rapid. Technical performance will be prioritized through lazy-loading high-fidelity assets and implementing WebP format standards to eliminate latency. Every service page will feature a 'Real-Time Interest' social proof ticker (e.g., '4 people viewed this treatment today') and a collapsible FAQ section to preemptively resolve conversion objections. The color palette relies on deep forest-toned primary anchoring, paired with soft champagne secondary tones and muted earth-clay accents to maintain a luxurious, grounded, and approachable aesthetic. The overall build must shift from a 'we-focused' narrative to a 'you-focused' experience, utilizing bulleted benefit lists that highlight the emotional and physical outcomes of each procedure, ensuring the user feels seen and understood from the first scroll. This architecture ensures the site functions as a high-performance sales engine while maintaining the boutique, high-end identity of the NUVO brand.

IMAGERY: Editorial-style, high-key photography featuring soft, golden-hour natural light to emphasize skin texture and clinic warmth. Compositions prioritize macro-detail shots of treatment precision alongside authentic, unposed portraits of providers interacting with patients in a serene, high-end environment, color-graded with warm, desaturated highlights and deep, professional shadows.

BRAND (CLIENT-CONFIRMED — use these EXACT values, do not substitute): primary #000000, secondary #B69C76, accent #E6E3D3; headings Tenor Sans, body Lora. These were read from the client's existing site (https://nuvoaestheticsclinic.com) and confirmed by the client.
